Area.evidence_source: [/page/13/Text/2] Findings from this qualitative study highlight the importance of spirituality and/or religion in veteran experiences of dealing with suicide ideation. [/page/13/Text/2] This study supports the development and evaluation of interventions that help veterans integrate functional aspects of their spirituality /religion into suicide safety plans and mental health recovery, while addressing aspects of spirituality/religion that might contribute to suicidality and suffering.
